meta.title: 用胯走路，腿更直更健康
meta.title_en: Walk With Your Hips for Straighter, Healthier Legs
meta.topic: 体态训练 · 用胯走路

scenes.title_en: The Core: Let the Hips Lead the Feet
scenes.context: 走路时不要靠脚往前迈，要用胯去走路。胯在屁股横移过来的两边这个位置。胯提起来，然后带着脚去走；胯提起来之后脚顺势往前迈就可以了。语域：体态教学，动作讲解。
sentences: 走路时不要靠脚往前迈，要用胯去走路。
Don't stride with your feet — walk with your hips.
stride with your feet（靠脚往前迈）
胯在你屁股横移过来的两边这个位置。
Your hips sit on both sides where your butt curves out.
where your butt curves out（屁股横移过来的位置）
胯提起来，然后带着脚去走。
Lift the hip, then let the foot follow along.
let the foot follow（带着脚走）
paraphrase: 用胯走路 → walk with your hips / hip-led walking
带着脚走 → let the foot follow / drag the foot along
scenes.speak: Don't stride with your feet — walk with your hips. Your hips sit on both sides where your butt curves out. Lift the hip, then let the foot follow along.

scenes.title_en: The Contrast: Walking With Feet Only
scenes.context: 很多人的问题：两个脚就这样走走走，胯完全没有动。现在把胯动起来：两个手扶着胯部，把右脚脚尖垫起来、膝盖伸直往上垫，放下来；左边同样。肩膀要稳住不动。语域：体态教学，正反示范。
sentences: 很多人是两脚走，胯完全没有动。
Many people just shuffle their feet — hips completely still.
shuffle their feet（两脚走）
右脚尖垫起来，膝盖伸直往上垫。
Lift your right toes, straighten the knee, and push up.
straighten the knee（膝盖伸直）
肩膀要稳住不动。
Keep your shoulders steady.
shoulders steady（肩膀稳住）
paraphrase: 垫脚尖 → lift your toes / rise onto the ball of the foot
lift toes · ball of the foot
稳住不动 → steady / hold still
scenes.speak: Many people just shuffle their feet — hips completely still. Lift your right toes, straighten the knee, and push up. Keep your shoulders steady.

scenes.title_en: Next Level: Rise High and Push the Hip
scenes.context: 垫的时候腰要用力，把胯顶到极限去。加速走，一二三四五六。超级棒！语域：体态教学，动作进阶。
sentences: 垫的时候，腰要用力。
Engage your core as you rise.
engage your core（腰要用力）
把胯顶到极限去。
Push your hip all the way to its limit.
push to the limit（顶到极限）
好，加速走，一二三四五六。
Now speed it up — one, two, three, four, five, six.
speed it up（加速）
paraphrase: 腰要用力 → engage your core / activate the lower back
顶到极限 → push to the limit / to the max
push to limit · to the max
scenes.speak: Engage your core as you rise. Push your hip all the way to its limit. Now speed it up — one, two, three, four, five, six.

scenes.title_cn: 完整步态：胯提腿伸落地
scenes.title_en: Full Gait: Hip Up, Leg Out, Heel Down
scenes.context: 接下来看我：把胯提起来，把脚也抬起来，然后大腿不要动，小腿伸出去，落地脚后跟。另外一边胯提起来，脚往前延伸落地。左、右往上，提高，腰胯往上，肩膀不动。语域：体态教学，完整步态。
sentences: 胯提起来，大腿不动，小腿伸出去。
Hip up, thigh still, calf reaching out.
thigh still（大腿不动）
落地要用脚后跟。
Land on your heel.
land on your heel（落地脚后跟）
腰胯往上，肩膀不动。
Core and hips lift; shoulders stay still.
core and hips lift（腰胯往上）
paraphrase: 小腿伸出去 → calf reaching out / extend the lower leg
落地脚后跟 → land on your heel / heel strike
scenes.speak: Hip up, thigh still, calf reaching out. Land on your heel. Core and hips lift; shoulders stay still.

practice: Don't stride with your feet — walk with your hips.
Many people just shuffle their feet — hips completely still.
Push your hip all the way to its limit.
Hip up, thigh still, calf reaching out.
pitfalls: Don't stride with your feet — walk with your hips.
Lift your toes and push up.
「垫脚尖」用 lift your toes / rise on the ball of the foot。
Hip up, thigh still, calf reaching out.
「大腿不动，小腿伸出」用 thigh still, calf reaching out。
shifts: 用 stride（迈步）、shuffle（拖着脚走）、hip-led walking（用胯走路）
用 engage your core（核心发力）、push to the limit（顶到极限）、rise on the ball of the foot（垫脚尖）
用 calf reaching out（小腿伸出）、heel strike（脚后跟落地）、steady（稳住）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：立马→两腿、换时间→换边、腰要用力、顶到极限、落地脚后跟、小腿伸出去、大腿不要动、腰胯往上、肩膀不动等。
